coupled.invariant_readout: logpower mean/std,lag1/2 normalized complex correlation,4 positional logpower means
coupled.interpretation: Received relative filter/polynomial energy is retained by normalization;not recovered TX PA/IQ coefficients or arbitrary RX/channel invariance
coupled.normalization_scope: one complex power mean across all channels and time per packet per block
coupled.relative_energy_after_gate: may change through learned radial gate;not fixed
coupled.waveform_operator: x[n]exp(-j alpha omega n);raw variant returns x exactly
coupled.alignment_interpretation: fixed received frequency retention;not TX/RX oscillator proportion
coupled.behavior_input: clipped z(n-m) times averaged causal envelope powers0/1/2

coupled.interpretation: Received relative filter/polynomial energy is retained by normalization;not recovered TX PA/IQ coefficients or arbitrary RX/channel invariance

coupled.interpretation: Received relative filter/polynomial energy is retained by normalization;not recovered TX PA/IQ coefficients or arbitrary RX/channel invariance

coupled.behavior_input: clipped z(n-m) times averaged causal envelope powers0/1/2

coupled.interpretation: Received relative filter/polynomial energy is retained by normalization;not recovered TX PA/IQ coefficients or arbitrary RX/channel invariance

coupled.behavior_input: clipped z(n-m) times averaged causal envelope powers0/1/2

coupled.interpretation: Received relative filter/polynomial energy is retained by normalization;not recovered TX PA/IQ coefficients or arbitrary RX/channel invariance

coupled.behavior_input: clipped z(n-m) times averaged causal envelope powers0/1/2
